sources.title: Qwen3.5-0.8B-NVFP4 huggingface.co api & AxionML Qwen3.5-0.8B-NVFP4 ...
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-.8B-NVFP4 is an open source model from GitHub that offers a free installation service, and any user can find Qwen3.5-.8B-NVFP4 on GitHub to install. At the same time, huggingface.co provides the effect of Qwen3.5-.8B-NVFP4 install, users can directly use Qwen3.5-.8B-NVFP4 installed effect in huggingface.co for debugging and trial. It also supports api for free installation.
